subject: Genetics
title: Diet Shapes Your Epigenome
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Diet Shapes Your Epigenome.

hook.text: Feed a pregnant agouti mouse folate and her pups turn brown and slim. Without folate, they're yellow and obese.

buildup.text: The agouti gene controls coat color and appetite.

discovery.text: Folate, B12, and choline provide methyl groups.

twist.text: The mother's diet during pregnancy determined her pups' health for life.

climax.text: This was the first clear proof that diet directly alters epigenetic marks with visible, lasting health consequences.

punchline.text: Same gene. Different diet. Opposite health outcomes.

quiz.question: What nutrient silenced the agouti gene in mice?
